entities.summary: Banteay Samré is a temple at Angkor, Cambodia, located 400 metres to the east of the East Baray. Built during the reign of Suryavarman II and Yasovarman II in the early 12th century, it is a Hindu temple in the Angkor Wat style. Banteay Samré is a archaeological site from Asia. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
